groups.condition: The array's nesting depth was accepted by parsing.
groups.capability: Print the array at every parser-accepted depth.
groups.consequence: Printing fails solely because of its depth.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three concern printing parser-produced arrays within the parser's accepted depth range.

groups.condition: The object's nesting depth was accepted by parsing.
groups.capability: Print the object at every parser-accepted depth.
groups.consequence: Printing fails solely because of its depth.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three concern printing parser-produced objects within the parser's accepted depth range.

groups.operation: print_value prints a cJSON_Raw child of an array or object
groups.condition: A valid supported input and setup contains a cJSON_Raw child.
groups.capability: Reach Raw child printing through array or object child delegation.
groups.consequence: The harness cannot exercise that Raw child printing path.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both pose the same conditional coverage hypothesis for Raw children in either container type.

groups.operation: print_array prints a constructed array tree
groups.condition: An array reaches output depth CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
groups.capability: Reach print_array's depth-limit rejection using public array construction APIs.
groups.consequence: The harness cannot exercise the new print failure.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three target the new rejection of a constructed array at the nesting limit.

groups.operation: print_object prints a constructed object tree
groups.condition: An object reaches output depth CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
groups.capability: Reach print_object's depth-limit rejection using public object construction APIs.
groups.consequence: The harness cannot exercise the new print failure.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three target the new rejection of a constructed object at the nesting limit.

groups.condition: An array contains a constructed cJSON_Raw element.
groups.capability: Reach print_value's Raw rendering through print_array.
groups.consequence: The parse-only harness cannot exercise Raw array element printing.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both target printing a Raw array element and identify the same missing construction path.

groups.operation: print_object prints a cJSON_Raw member value
groups.condition: An object contains a constructed cJSON_Raw member value.
groups.capability: Reach print_value's Raw rendering through print_object.
groups.consequence: The parse-only harness cannot exercise Raw object member printing.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three target printing a Raw object member and identify the same missing construction path.
